_doc: Frozen crosswalk and method for human-vs-AI extraction inter-rater reliability (Stage 6). Deposited as the OSF artifact backing the section 12 kappa claim. This file plus kappa.py reproduce the reported value.
review: Quantum Computing for Medical Imaging Applications (IEEE TRPMS)
method: Composite Cohen's kappa by stratified pooling. Observed agreement P_o pooled across all scored cells. Chance term P_e = cell-count-weighted average of each field's own marginal chance agreement (sum_k p_h(k)*p_a(k) per field). kappa=(P_o-P_e)/(1-P_e). Not a naive pooled confusion matrix.
scope: Human-filled extraction cells compared against the corresponding AI cell. Cells filled on only one side are coverage gaps and excluded.

locked_parameters.data_release_on_request: human value containing an on-request marker counts as NOT released (false), overriding any yes prefix
locked_parameters.overall_kappa_definition: composite stratified (this file's method); NOT simple mean of per-field kappa

excluded_from_kappa.dataset_type: human wrote free-text dataset descriptions, not the enum
excluded_from_kappa.dataset_realism_grade: human used low/moderate/high scale; AI used source-type enum (different construct)
excluded_from_kappa.clinical_impact_claim: human boolean not_reported vs AI extracted claim sentence
excluded_from_kappa.computational_cost_training: human yes/no vs AI free-text cost
excluded_from_kappa.computational_cost_inference: human yes/no vs AI free-text cost
excluded_from_kappa.sample_size_justification_reported: human wrote rationale prose, not boolean (decision 4: exclude)
excluded_from_kappa.external_validation_used: human wrote rationale prose, not boolean (decision 4: exclude)

normalisation.boolean_rule: human: lowercased value startswith 'yes' -> true, else false. AI: literal true/false token.
normalisation.cross_validation_rule: contains 'fold' -> k_fold; contains 'split' or '%' or a digit-digit ratio -> holdout; not-reported family -> NULL.
normalisation.multivalue: split on ';' or ',', normalise each token, form a set.
normalisation.matching_relation_lenient: sets share at least one token OR one set is a subset of the other -> agree.

results.interpretation: Both numbers are reported. The floor isolates synonym/format normalisation only; the difference to the normalised value reflects granularity collapse and subset-overlap scoring. The crosswalk was developed on the observed human-AI pairs (data-derived, not blind) and is disclosed as such.
